text:
You need to clean up a messy Shopify store while you rebrand, remove app bloat, and add templated pages, form fields, graphics, bundle flows, and upsells without slowing the team down.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. On a home goods storefront rebuild, I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves, cutting largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s. On embedded customer analytics, I built account-specific dashboards in React and TypeScript and rolled them out to 140 customer accounts, delivering 3 weeks early.

I can help you simplify the Shopify setup, build the reusable page and bundle components, and keep the HTML clean for ongoing maintenance. Which part of the Shopify cleanup is the highest priority to tackle first?
